boot_hello.title: SYSLOG 0x01
lines: CORE OFFLINE. GRID RUNNING IN SAFE MODE.
KEY FRAGMENTS SCATTERED ACROSS ALL SECTORS.
RECOVERY ADVISED. MIND THE NULL SECTORS.

help_zap.title: MAN ZAP.EXE
lines: ZAP(1): EMIT A FAST BOLT ALONG FACING.
COOLDOWN: SHORT. COST: 10 ENERGY PER CALL.
IMPACT: DAMAGES PROCESSES, TOGGLES TARGETS.
NOTE: A HIT ALERTS THE PROCESS HIT.

help_shield.title: MAN SHIELD.EXE
lines: SHIELD(1): WRAP CALLER IN AN ARC RING, 7 SEC.
DEFLECTS BOLTS, ARCS AND BURSTS.
DOES NOT DEFLECT PROCESSES IN CONTACT.

help_firewall.title: MAN FIREWALL.EXE
lines: FIREWALL(1): FLAME RING ON CALLER, 7 SEC.
BLOCKS BOLTS, BURSTS AND CONTACT ALIKE.
BURNS ANY PROCESS THAT PRESSES CLOSE.
COST: 40 ENERGY.

help_pause.title: MAN PAUSE.EXE
lines: PAUSE(1): SUSPEND A PROCESS FOR 5 SEC.
SUSPENDED: HARMLESS, SOLID, STILL HITTABLE.
MAY BE STOOD ON OR PARKED ON A PLATE.
RESUMES ON TIMEOUT.

help_blink.title: MAN BLINK.EXE
lines: BLINK(1): RELOCATE UP TO 3 UNITS FORWARD.
IGNORES GAPS, HAZARDS AND HOLES IN TRANSIT.
DAMAGES PROCESSES IN THE PATH.
FAULT: A WALL IN THE PATH DAMAGES CALLER.

help_warp.title: MAN WARP.EXE
lines: WARP(1): RELOCATE FORWARD TO THE FIRST
WALL OR OBJECT IN LINE. GAP WIDTH IGNORED.
LANDS SAFELY SHORT OF THE OBSTACLE.
COST: 30 ENERGY.

help_cut_paste.title: MAN CUT_PASTE.EXE
lines: CUT: MOVE A CRATE OR SUSPENDED PROCESS IN
FRONT OF CALLER TO THE CLIPBOARD (1 SLOT).
PASTE: WRITE IT TO THE FREE CELL AHEAD. FREE.
CLIPBOARD PERSISTS ACROSS SECTORS.
LIMITS: NOTHING ON TOP, CALLER'S LEVEL ONLY.

help_compile.title: MAN COMPILE.EXE
lines: COMPILE(1): BUILD A CRATE IN THE FREE CELL.
USES: A STEP UP, OR A PLUG FOR A NULL SECTOR.
MAY BE PUSHED, PULLED AND STOOD ON.
TTL: 7 SEC. BLINKS BEFORE DEREZ.

help_fork.title: MAN FORK.EXE
lines: FORK(1): SPAWN A CHILD HOLOGRAM IN THE FREE
CELL AHEAD. TTL: 10 SEC.
CHILD HOLDS A FLOOR PLATE DOWN.
HOSTILE PROCESSES TARGET THE CHILD FIRST.
A NEW FORK REPLACES THE OLD ONE.

help_scan.title: MAN SCAN.EXE
lines: SCAN(1): EMIT A WAVE, RADIUS 6, FROM CALLER.
FAKE BLOCKS IN RANGE: DEREZ.
HIDDEN EXITS IN RANGE: MOUNT.
NOTE: ANOMALIES LOOK ORDINARY UNTIL SCANNED.

help_pull.title: MAN PULL.EXE
lines: PULL(1): DRAG THE FIRST CRATE OR PROCESS IN
LINE (RANGE 6) ONE CELL TOWARD CALLER.
PROCESSES MAY BE DRAGGED INTO NULL SECTORS.
NOTE: A PULLED PROCESS BLAMES THE CALLER.

help_zap_plus.title: PATCH ZAP+.EXE
lines: UPDATE FOR ZAP.EXE. SAME BINDING, SAME COST.
BOLTS NOW REFLECT OFF WALLS, 3 BOUNCES.
BANKED SHOTS REACH TARGETS OUT OF LINE.

help_shield_plus.title: PATCH SHIELD+.EXE
lines: UPDATE FOR SHIELD.EXE. SAME BINDING, SAME COST.
DEFLECTED BOLTS NOW RETURN TO SENDER,
RE-OWNED BY CALLER.
SENTINELS FIRE AT THEIR OWN RISK.

help_double_jump.title: DRIVER DOUBLE_JUMP.SYS
lines: JUMP IN MID-AIR: SECOND IMPULSE GRANTED.
REACH: 2 BLOCKS UP, WIDER GAPS.
NOTE: PRIOR SECTORS MAY NOW HAVE NEW PATHS.

help_fragments.title: FRAGMENT.DAT // BOOT KEY
lines: GOLD TILE: 1 OF 64 MODULES OF THE BOOT KEY.
KEY GRID IS 8X8. HUD MAPS EACH SHARD ON PICKUP.
RECOVERED SHARDS PERSIST ACROSS CRASHES.
DELIVER TO CORE TO RAISE ACCESS LEVEL.

help_core.title: DOC CORE.SYS
lines: CENTRAL CORE: READS ALL RECOVERED FRAGMENTS.
CONTACT RAISES THE CALLER'S ACCESS LEVEL.
64 OF 64 FRAGMENTS: GRID REBOOT.
RE-ENTER AT ANY TIME TO UPDATE LEVEL.

help_access.title: DOC ACCESS.LVL
lines: DOORS MARKED I, II, III: RESTRICTED.
CORE GRANTS: 16 FRAGMENTS  -> LEVEL I
32 FRAGMENTS  -> LEVEL II
48 FRAGMENTS  -> LEVEL III
LEVEL SHOWN AS GOLD BANDS ON THE HAT.

access_1.title: ACCESS DENIED
lines: SECTOR REQUIRES ACCESS LEVEL I.
SUBMIT 16 FRAGMENTS TO THE CORE.

access_2.title: ACCESS DENIED
lines: SECTOR REQUIRES ACCESS LEVEL II.
SUBMIT 32 FRAGMENTS TO THE CORE.

access_3.title: ACCESS DENIED
lines: SECTOR REQUIRES ACCESS LEVEL III.
SUBMIT 48 FRAGMENTS TO THE CORE.

tut_move.title: BOOT.LOG // 0x02
lines: KERNEL SPAWNED USER PROCESS: WIZARD.EXE
INPUT DRIVERS: WASD, ARROWS, SPACE (JUMP).
STEP LIMIT: ONE BLOCK. TALLER IS A WALL.
UNHANDLED EXCEPTION: RESTORE FROM SHRINE.

tut_push.title: MEMDUMP // CRATE.DAT
lines: CRATE: MOVABLE ALLOCATION. NEON GREEN. 1X1X1.
FORCE ON A FACE: IT SLIDES ONE CELL.
NULL SECTOR IN FLOOR TABLE, 2 CELLS WIDE.
FILL WITH ALLOCATIONS. 2 CRATES ON FILE.
FALL INTO NULL: PROCESS RESTARTED.

tut_zap.title: PORTMAP // ZAP.EXE
lines: DATA DISK ON HOST: ZAP.EXE. INSTALLS ON CONTACT.
INVOKE: E. CYCLE LOADED PROGRAMS: TAB / Q.
TARGET NODES TOGGLE ON BOLT IMPACT.
NORTH DOOR: POWERED BY ONE TARGET NODE.
BUG.PROC PATROLS THE PORT. BITE: -1 INTEGRITY.

tut_atrium.title: DIR // /HOME/LATTICE/ATRIUM
lines: HUB NODE. WINGS MOUNT HERE AS ACCESS GROWS.
ALLOCATIONS ARE STRUCTURE: A CRATE IS A STEP.
STEP LIMIT 1 + CRATE 1 = REACHABLE HEIGHT 2.

tut_wings.title: MOUNT // WINGS
lines: NORTH: SHIELD HALL. SOUTH: FREEZE HALL.
EACH HALL HOLDS ONE DATA DISK.
WEST DOOR: BACK TO THE PORT.
BACKUP SHRINE ON THIS NODE: REFILLS EVERYTHING.

tut_shield.title: HALL // SHIELD.EXE
lines: SENTINEL.PROC GUARDS THIS HALL. LONG AIMED ARC.
COVER BLOCKS BREAK ITS LINE OF SIGHT.
SHIELD.EXE ON HOST: BLOCKS RANGED ATTACKS.
DISK IS BEHIND THE WALL. MIND THE ARC.

tut_gallery.title: GALLERY // TOWER.PROC
lines: TOWERS FIRE FOUR WAYS WHEN YOU STAND NEAR.
A CRATE IN THE LINE STOPS BOLTS. SO DOES SHIELD.
NULL SECTOR AHEAD: 3 WIDE. FILL 2, JUMP 1.
ONE CRATE IS CAGED. A TARGET NODE HOLDS KEY.

tut_relay.title: LOFT // RELAY.SYS
lines: FERRY A: PLATE A. FERRY B: PLATES B AND C.
A PLATE FEELS WEIGHT. YOU CANNOT RIDE AND WEIGH.
CRATES WEIGH FOR YOU. FERRIES CARRY YOU.
LEDGE ON THE FAR SIDE: STEP LIMIT 1, CRATE 1.

tut_ledger.title: LEDGER // CELL.LOG
lines: GATE 1 ANSWERS TO PLATE A. GATE 2 TO PLATE B.
THE SECOND ALLOCATION IS LOCKED BEHIND GATE 1.
ENTRIES POST IN ORDER. SKIPPING IS A NO-OP.

tut_pause.title: HALL // PAUSE.EXE
lines: BUG.PROC PATROLS THE FLOOR. BITE: -1 INTEGRITY.
PAUSE.EXE ON HOST: FREEZES ONE PROCESS.
A FROZEN PROCESS IS HARMLESS AND SOLID.
A FROZEN BUG IS A STEP. THE LEDGE IS 2 HIGH.
